text:
tasha: noticed a weird cascade in ap-south1 tonight — NVMe remap churn + transient metadata checksum errors, took a handful of GPU nodes OOS for attach.
liam: which nodes and how many GPUs impacted?
tasha: gnode-412, gnode-417, gnode-433. ~24 GPUs failing attach, scheduler holding pods. sample from kernel: 
```
[400123.123] nvme0: remap shrink/growth churn, meta_checksum=bad, remap_retry=5
[400125.999] nvme0: metadata sync failed -EIO, fallback_retries=3
```
dario: was there a network hiccup? we had a fabric flap earlier at 23:12 UTC but it healed. Could be concurrent scrub + network causing fsyncs to stall.
tasha: timeline: fabric flap 23:12, scrub window kicked 23:15, errors started 23:18. correlation strong.
sre-bot: ALERT ap-south1 nvme.meta_checksum_failures=320 in 15m incident=INC-20260402-0044
liam: mitigations? cross-region spill? ops wants to keep Dedicated lanes healthy.
harper: cost estimate for moving those jobs to us-east1 for a day ~ $1.5k (egress + spot churn). Prefer local mitigations first.
dario: propose: 1) pause scrub runner for these nodes, 2) mark nodes in scheduler as avoid-pool for new attaches, 3) drain affected GPUs for graceful failover, 4) enqueue firmware-rollforward check later.
tasha: I'm pausing scrubs on gnode-412/417/433 now. applying annotation: `warehouse.redwood/scrub-paused=true`.
liam: set scheduler taint to keep new workloads off: `kubectl taint nodes gnode-412 gpu.attach-block=1:NoSchedule` - doing gnode-412/417/433/440/449.
sre-bot: NOTE drain jobs initiated for pods on gnode-412 - drain_id=DRN-881
harper: ops-lead, notify any Dedicated customers with attachments in ap-south1?
ops-lead: pinging customer success to flag impacted routes. we might need to offer fallbacks.
dario: also throttle janitor globally in ap-south1 to concurrency=1 and extend inter-scrub backoff by 2x. pushing config patch.
liam: logs show remap churn dropping after scrub pause. attach retries decreasing.
tasha: good. we'll hold taints for 90m, then start re-evaluating. please collect block device SMART data and scrub metrics for a postmortem.
harper: open ticket STORAGE-801 to track checksum spike and firmware history. also flag the fabric flap as contributing cause: NET-404.
sre-bot: RESOLVE incident=INC-20260402-0044 when meta_checksum_failures < 10/15m for 30m
ops-lead: thanks team. after 90m we will gradually remove taints and resume scrubs with a canary on gnode-440. if we see regression, prepare cross-region failover.
dario: will draft RFC for scrub+network interlock to avoid concurrent heavy IO during fabric recoveries. link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/scrub-network-coordination
tasha: monitoring dashboards look stable. closing thread after 1h stable window. :white_check_mark:
